items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a little guy from Ohio named PeeWee Jackson, Harry Jackson.

ctx.x: But he played the 5100 club there which became famous. And I talked this guy into broadcasting from the 5100 Club. This guy was a millionaire that owned it. He wouldn't owe you a dime, and he wouldn't lend you a dime, one of those things. He was one of the few Chicago cash whiskey buyers, nightclub owners, and he was like that. But I felt as if I had done something great. I talked the guy into bringing WBBM in there and (unintelligible) but it paid off. And I had a great band there. This is when I had Walter…
